land_area_metric.rule: carry forward unless concrete land event changes it; Round 65 adds 0.125 sq mi after a fresh survey of the newly seized final-refuge tract

special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category. Every round performs one independent random Special-event roll using the current base probability. A successful roll adds exactly one initially Special event; a failed roll adds none. Each successful Magnitude-11 check also produces one initially Special event. Magnitude-11 is separate from the standard Special roll. Initial Special or Surprise classification is not automatically Ultimate, but every such candidate is subject to the mandatory Ultimate Reclassification Gate before final classification.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_policy: tracked separately from Special-event selection; a successful Magnitude-11 check generates an initially Special event, which must independently pass the Ultimate Reclassification Gate before its final category is committed.

continuity.campaign_development: 12 October 57 BCE: the petitioned shared-water road has been completed and opened; local carts and water carriers now use it; the caravan merchants have entered a long-term surplus-delivery agreement; the first contracted delivery has realized 22 denarii net profit with the canonical 10% private transfer; Celer has received a substantive reply; the new traffic has exposed another section of older roadwork; and one more wounded veteran has returned to field service.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 sq mi; Round 42 adds 0.25; Round 55 establishes 7.0625; Round 59 adds 0.50; Round 65 adds 0.125; Round 75 adds 0.0625 to reach 7.75; Round 98 adds 0.0625 to reach 7.8125; Round 99 adds 0.125 sq mi (80 acres) to reach 7.9375. The Round 99 tract is the largest single recorded acquisition.
continuity.personal_guard: 100 total: 50 infantry and 50 cavalry; no change in composition this round.

valerius_equipment.shield_piercing_record: truthful record for every confirmed shield personally pierced

continuity.road_investigation: Increased traffic exposed a short section of older prepared ground near the damaged crossing. Builder, date, authority, and original purpose remain unresolved.
continuity.political_correspondence: Valerius has sent a fuller reply to Quintus Caecilius Metellus Celer; no office, command, payment, or binding commitment exists.
continuity.commercial_thread: Foreign caravan merchants have signed a continuing surplus-delivery agreement. The first contracted consignment has been delivered and paid; future consignments remain unrealized until completed.
continuity.local_infrastructure_thread: Smallholders have submitted a written shared-road petition; no construction or expenditure has occurred.
continuity.road_thread: The shared-water road is physically complete and in legitimate local use; merchant traffic has begun and the route supports the new long-term delivery contract.
continuity.estate_consolidation: Automatic adjoining-property acquisition remains active; no new purchase was required this round.
continuity.medical_recovery: Temporary unavailable strength has fallen from four to three after one more veteran returned to ordinary field service.

character_registry.rule: Recurring named characters are persistent simulation entities. Established characters must be considered during every round and reused by name when contextually involved. Generic labels may be used only for genuinely unidentified groups or when no named individual is supported by prior continuity.

characters.continuity: persisted relationship; may appear when contextually relevant

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.

exact_quantity_rule: Exact quantities retain their explicit units and are not converted into condition points. Financial effects are represented through ai_ledger.financial_realization and account balances, not a currency metric.

financial_policy.rule: Economic activity need not explicitly mention income. Realized financial effects are intermittent consequences recorded in the ledger when the event provides a concrete basis.

account_routing.treasury: state, military, public-command, or explicitly public/state funds
account_routing.private_account: Valerius private wealth and established private transfers
account_routing.financial_realization: event-level financial effects recorded inside ai_ledger.financial_realization

financial_policy.double_counting_rule: Transfers between accounts are not new income; gross receipts, costs, net public profit, private transfers, principal, and realized returns remain distinct.
financial_policy.historical_reconciliation: Documented past financial blocks remain canonical. Missing historical income is not fabricated. Legacy currency_units are interpreted as denarii while source uncertainty is preserved.

ten_percent_realized_profit_transfer.rule: 10% of realized net public profit is routed to Valerius's private account; the remaining 90% remains in the public account. This is an account-routing rule, not new external income.

canonical_pointer_policy.rule: The canonical round is determined by synchronized scenario/state/round records, never by the newest-looking file, filename, search result, or legacy schema record.

legacy_round_records.round-014.json: historical record; never a latest-round pointer
legacy_round_records.round-052.json: historical legacy-schema record; never a latest-round pointer

canonical_pointer_policy.artifact_exclusion_rule: Historical or legacy records may remain for audit but cannot override the synchronized canonical pointer.

ultimate_event_policy.definition: Ultimate is a core event category reserved for extraordinary circumstances that warrant an unusually detailed, cinematic account because the event is materially exceptional within the campaign.
ultimate_event_policy.purpose: Preserve major expeditions, crises, discoveries, confrontations, breakthroughs, disasters, or similarly exceptional developments without overwriting ordinary events.
ultimate_event_policy.clarification: Ultimate may be retrospective when a major earlier development is formally reconstructed later. It uses the same required event fields and fixed AI ledger. It does not replace Direct, Connected, Surprise, or Special; it is not a probability system and does not bypass metric bounds or financial rules.
ultimate_event_policy.usage_rule: Generate Ultimate only when campaign context supports extraordinary circumstances. Do not force one every round.
ultimate_event_policy.narrative_rule: Ultimate narratives may be substantially longer and more cinematic than ordinary news, emphasizing sequence, setting, hardship, decisions, consequences, and continuity while remaining grounded in established campaign facts.
ultimate_event_policy.reclassification_rule: Every event initially classified as Surprise or Special must be inspected after generation and before final output. If its actual circumstances independently satisfy the Ultimate definition, its final event_category becomes Ultimate and the narrative is rewritten to Ultimate depth. If not, its original category remains. This is a one-way post-generation gate and does not alter the underlying random result.

event_category_hierarchy.classification_note: Event category describes how an event enters the simulation at generation time; final classification is locked only after the mandatory Ultimate Reclassification Gate. Ultimate identifies extraordinary circumstances requiring exceptional narrative treatment, while Special remains independently probabilistic.
event_category_hierarchy.prose_rule: Direct, Connected, Surprise, and Special events use the established player-facing prose/news schema. Surprise and Special receive the expanded prose/news treatment required by the campaign and are not shortened merely because of their initial category. Every initially Surprise or Special event is then inspected by the Ultimate Reclassification Gate; qualifying events are renamed to Ultimate and rewritten at Ultimate narrative depth before output. Ultimate is the final classification only when the event independently meets the Ultimate threshold.

event_minimum_policy.rule: Every GMV round must contain at least 7 distinct events. This is the only additional event-count requirement. All existing causal-generation, event-category, variety, continuity, random-resolution, financial, metric, and validation rules remain unchanged. The minimum does not permit unrelated filler; each event must arise from an existing or newly emerging plausible causal thread supported by the established simulation state.
